question: After the pointer correction and ignore-rule proof are added, should an authorized repository admin or security reviewer approve the final `.gitignore` head?
rationale: Repository automation intentionally blocks this security-sensitive path, so only an authorized human can accept the exact-head change even though the rule strengthens secret-file protection.

options.title: Revise, prove, then authorize
options.body: Have the contributor correct the infra scope and add `git check-ignore`/tracked-template output, then authorize the resulting exact head.

options.title: Keep the PR docs-only
options.body: Drop the `.gitignore` commit and land only the corrected agent-guidance changes without invoking the security-sensitive path.

recommendation.title: Revise, prove, then authorize
recommendation.body: Have the contributor correct the infra scope and add `git check-ignore`/tracked-template output, then authorize the resulting exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent root `AGENTS.md` policy history makes steipete the best available routing candidate, though any authorized admin or security reviewer may make the final authorization.
